CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK( PF_Date_Passed__c ), TODAY() - DATEVALUE (CreatedDate), PF_Date_Passed__c - DATEVALUE (CreatedDate))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This is the number of days the test case assignment has aged since created. If the assignment is still open, then it calculates from Today - Created Date. If the assignment is passed, then it calculates from Date Passed - Created Date.
CustomField.label: Age (In Days)
